plan.title: Kidney treated vs control DE with batch-adjusted DESeq2
plan.analytical_narrative: 12 kidney bulk RNA-seq samples (6 treated, 6 control) from salmon, 12000 genes, with two processing batches balanced across condition. Because the batch is balanced across condition (each batch holds both conditions), it is modeled as a covariate rather than corrected out of the counts: design = ~batch + condition, testing the condition coefficient. QC first confirms whether batch or condition dominates sample structure. Low-count genes are minimally pre-filtered; DESeq2's internal median-of-ratios normalization and independent filtering do the rest. DESeq2 Wald test is the primary DE call, with an edgeR quasi-likelihood run on the same design as a robustness cross-check (intersection = high-confidence set). apeglm shrinks the condition log2FC for ranking/plotting. BH-adjusted p<0.05 defines DE genes. Enrichment runs fgsea preranked on the full gene list (Wald statistic) against MSigDB Hallmark first, then Reactome and WikiPathways as follow-up collections, per the grounded procedure. A final report step consolidates diagnostics, gene tables, enrichment results, and a full reproducibility record.

Benjamini-Hochberg FDR with independent filtering, alpha=0.05
fgsea preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark, then Reactome and WikiPathways
DE + enrichment report with diagnostics, reproducibility record
